targets.rawSql: select replay_id, owner_runtime, dry_run, impact, status, requested_by, approved_by, authorization_expires_at, created_at from replay_operation_schedules where deleted_at is null order by created_at desc limit 50
select stream_name, status, checked_events, gap_count, duplicate_count, checked_at from event_store_integrity_checks where deleted_at is null order by checked_at desc limit 50

select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, dimensions->>'owner_runtime' as metric, max(metric_value) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.replay.lag.seconds' and deleted_at is null group by 1, 2 order by 1
